description: Plan a meal on a date (optionally repeating, link a recipe, add to grocery list).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD the meal is planned for.

rrule.description: iCal RRULE string for a repeating meal, e.g. "FREQ=DAILY;INTERVAL=1;UNTIL=20260626T235959Z" (meals use a plain rrule string, NOT an array).

summary.description: Meal name. LIVE-VERIFIED: when meal_recipe_id is set, this must be BLANK — pass "" and the sitting inherits its name from the linked recipe. Sending a non-blank summary together with a recipe id returns 422 {"errors":{"summary":["must be blank"]}}.

name: skylight_plan_meal
